title: sign() vs encrypt() inconsistent MIME-Version / message-vs-bodypart framing
description: encrypt() doc explicitly states 'This is the encrypted body part, not a complete RFC 5322 message. The caller must add message-level headers.' sign() has no equivalent disclaimer, yet it also produces headers (MIME-Version + Content-Type) but no From/To/Subject. Users will ask whether sign() output is a ready-to-send message. The asymmetry will generate issues. Fix: add the same disclaimer to sign() doc, or make both functions consistent in what they return.
